# hibira_account (Data Source)

Reads a customer account by ID or email. Needs the provider's `console_token` (scope `accounts:read`) and the Cloudflare Access service token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hibira_account" "demo" {
  email = "demo@example.com"
}

output "demo_plan" {
  value = data.hibira_account.demo.effective_plan
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) The account's email. Set this or `id`.
- `id` (String) The account ID. Set this or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `chat_beta` (Boolean) Whether the account is in the Chat API beta.
- `effective_plan` (String) The plan whose limits apply.
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the email is verified.
- `name` (String) The account's name.
- `note` (String) The operator note.
- `plan` (String) The plan the account pays for.
- `status` (String) The subscription status.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the account is suspended.
- `tags` (Set of String) The operator tags.
